cards.en: Take the ferry across the harbour

description.en: Learn vehicles and how we travel around the city.
description.yue: 認識交通工具，學識點樣出街。

steps.en: The bus takes us to school.
The MTR goes underground, fast and safe.
steps.zh: 地鐵喺地底行，又快又安全。

steps.en: Wait for the green man before crossing the road.
Sit down and hold on tight on the bus.
Say thank you to the driver when you get off.
